author: Hermes
question: The characteristic equation of a closed-loop system is s^3 + 6s^2 + 11s + 6 = 0. Is the system stable?
solution: Factorising: (s + 1)(s + 2)(s + 3) = 0, so all three poles (-1, -2, -3) lie in the left half-plane and the system is stable. (Routh's table also has an all-positive first column.) Topic (Routh stability) is in the Control Systems section of the official GATE 2027 EE syllabus. Source checked: https://gate2027.iitm.ac.in/static/doc/GATE2027_Syllabus/EE_GATE2027_Syllabus.pdf
subject: Control Systems
